guard_scope: Stage13 and subsequent explicitly strict coverage profiles hold size-loss candidates. Historical parser labels and legacy DB rows remain unchanged pending a versioned identity correction.

correction_decision.recommended: Retain every legacy ID/reference; append exact source-dimension/hold evidence and review compatibility before changing eligibility or exposing a bound image. New canonical source variants must include declared size; no implicit alias, price-series merge or standard-size fallback.
correction_decision.alternative: If future identity registry uses dimension-complete IDs, preserve legacy lookup mappings as reviewed relationships; do not silently rename or duplicate current rows.

audit_scope: Existing pinned TCGdex provenance paths only; other providers/API snapshots and unavailable bytes are unqualified, not a complete physical-card census.
